source_checks.finding: Page section is 'Pair a Bluetooth accessory through the Settings app' (card label 'Pairing a Bluetooth accessory through Settings' is close; card fix optional). The card excerpt 'Tap Pair new device.' is confirmed word for word. Page confirms the Android 15 caveat ('Some of these steps only work on Android 15 and up.') and the hardware caveat ('Some of these steps only work on devices with supporting hardware.'). Page also confirms: pull down from the top edge; press and hold Bluetooth; 'Pair new device' or check 'Available devices' or open More and select Refresh; tap the device name; complete the prompts; and the Fast Pair notification line ('automatically connect your Bluetooth devices with Fast Pair'). Applicability to an Android phone is confirmed.

Page is for Windows 11 (and Windows 10) and confirms the Windows 11 steps, the Bluetooth requirement (built in or USB adapter), 'Follow additional instructions if they appear, then select Done.' This is a correct distractor: the user has an Android phone, so the Windows passage does not apply and is correctly unused.

required_actions.action: Swipe down from the top of the screen
If Pair new device is missing, check Available devices, or tap More then Refresh
Tap the name of the Bluetooth device
If a notification to pair appears, use it to connect automatically with Fast Pair

findings: The last note in the target says 'your phone can connect automatically with Fast Pair' with no explanation. 'Fast Pair' is an unexplained product term, which the plain-words rule does not allow for this user. The clause is also not an action the user can take from the text.
correction_required: Replace the closing note 'If you see a notification to pair, your phone can connect automatically with Fast Pair. Some of these steps work only on Android 15 and up.' with 'If you see a notification to pair, you can use it to connect automatically. This is called Fast Pair. Some of these steps work only on Android 15 and up.' Keep all other steps unchanged.

source_checks.finding: Page section 'Connect a Bluetooth device with your Mac' confirms: 'Make sure the device is turned on and discoverable (see the device's documentation for details).' and 'You can also connect a Bluetooth device to your Mac by clicking the Bluetooth status menu in Control Centre and selecting the device.' The Settings sidebar steps (Apple menu, System Settings, Bluetooth, Hold the pointer over the device, click Connect) and 'If asked, click Accept (or enter a series of numbers, then press Enter).' are also on the page. The page's intro lists headphones as a device type, so the headphones fall under this ref. The card's exact exclusion sentence (for devices other than Apple wireless keyboards, mice and trackpads) is not on the page; the page only says Apple keyboards, mice and trackpads must be connected first. Card fix: restate applicability as Mac devices such as headphones. The UK page spells 'Control Centre'; the card's 'Control Center' is the same control.

required_actions.action: Make sure the headphones are turned on and discoverable
Click the Bluetooth status menu in Control Center and select the headphones
If prompted, click Accept or enter the number sequence shown and press Enter
